payload.notes:
SecureSH 0.1.13.

- RDP now works with xrdp and other non-TLS/NLA servers: falls back to standard RDP security automatically when the host refuses SSL (fixes SSL_NOT_ALLOWED_BY_SERVER). Windows hosts still use NLA + 32-bit colour.
- Auto-update no longer fires from a browser viewing the host (it was restarting the host app and dropping the browser). Only the desktop app updates itself now.

Includes the full UI redesign (0.1.12) and the reliable auto-updater (0.1.11).
